caption: The drawing shows a female doll with pale skin, standing on an oval-shaped gray platform. The doll has black hair styled in defined waves and a center part, and it is adorned with a blue necklace. She wears a dress with a floral pattern, predominantly in shades of light pink, red, and green. The dress has elbow-length sleeves and a scalloped, lace-trimmed edge at the collar and hem, as well as another layer of lace visible underneath the main skirt. A wide blue sash is tied around her waist, with a long blue ribbon draping down her right side. The doll's shoes are black, and her cheeks are colored a rosy pink. The background is a plain beige, and the lower right corner of the image bears the signature "Eugene Croe" in cursive lettering.
title: Doll - "Amelia"
